title: Air-fryer breaded prawns
subtitle: Raw prawns in a panko coating, air-fried until crisp.
excerpt: Large raw prawns coated in seasoned panko breadcrumbs and air-fried at high heat until the coating is crisp and the prawn is pink and cooked through. Ready in 10 minutes. Serves two as a starter or four as a snack.
sourceNotes: Breaded prawns are a preparation found across British pub food and international seafood cooking. The air fryer's high circulating heat crisps the panko coating without deep-frying, and the prawns cook through in the same time as the coating browns.

recipe.freezeNotes: Coat and freeze on a lined tray, then bag. Cook from frozen at 200°C for 12 minutes, flipping halfway.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Coat up to 2 hours ahead and refrigerate uncovered before cooking.

content.text: Breaded prawns in the air fryer get a proper crisp coating if the prawns are dried thoroughly and the panko is sprayed generously with oil before cooking. Use large raw prawns ,  small ones overcook before the coating browns. The whole process takes 10 minutes once the prawns are coated.

items.prepNote: large, peeled and deveined, tails on

content.text: Pat the {{prawns-raw}} of prawns completely dry. Mix {{breadcrumbs-panko}} of panko with {{garlic-powder}} of garlic powder and {{paprika-smoked}} of smoked paprika in a shallow bowl. Set up three bowls: seasoned {{plain-flour}}, {{eggs}} of beaten egg, and the spiced panko. Hold each prawn by the tail and dip in flour, then egg, then press into panko on all sides. Place on a plate.

Preheat the air fryer to 200°C. Spray the basket generously with cooking oil. Lay the prawns in a single layer. Spray the tops with oil. Cook for 4 minutes, flip, spray again, and cook for a further 3-4 minutes until the coating is golden and crisp and the prawn tails are pink and curled. Serve immediately with lemon wedges.

items.cause: Prawns not dried before coating, or skipped the flour stage.
items.fix: All three stages of the breading process are important. Flour gives the egg something to grip; egg gives the panko something to stick to.

items.cause: Left in too long after the coating browned.
items.fix: Pull as soon as the coating is golden. Prawns are done when pink and just curled.

items.cause: Not enough oil spray, or air fryer not preheated.
items.fix: Spray generously, preheat properly, and do not skimp on the oil. Panko needs fat to go golden.

content.text: Breaded prawns are a good starter or sharing snack. Serve with aioli, sweet chilli sauce, or tartare sauce. They also work in a po'boy-style roll with shredded lettuce and a squeeze of hot sauce.
